T: A new kind of enemy. A new kind of war.
D: A school jock from Buenos Aires joins the Mobile Infantry to follow his girlfriend and ends up on the front line of a war with giant bugs.
P: Serve the cauliflower when Zim turns up with the captured Brain Bug.
S: Cracked crab claws with lemon mayo. The drop on Klendathu goes badly.

Crack the claws with the back of a heavy knife so the shell opens. Melt the butter with the garlic and chilli until fragrant. Steam or warm the claws in a covered pan with a splash of water. Pour over the garlic butter, scatter with parsley and serve with lemon and bread.
Spiced beef empanadas baked golden. Rico is from Buenos Aires.

Brown the mince, add the onion, capsicum and spices and cook until soft, then cool and fold in the eggs and olives. Cut 12cm rounds from the pastry, fill, fold and crimp the edges. Brush with egg and bake at 200C until golden. Chop the parsley with a pinch of salt and stir in the vinegar and oil for chimichurri.
M: Whole roast cauliflower with brown butter. Zim captures the Brain Bug.

Boil the whole cauliflower for 6 minutes, then drain and dry. Rub with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt and roast at 220C until deep golden. Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, garlic and enough water to pour. Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff. Pour the tahini over the cauliflower, scatter with pomegranate and mint and carve at the table.
Beer-braised short ribs, mash and charred onions.

Brown the ribs well in a heavy pot, then lift out and colour the onions. Add the beer, stock, tomato paste and sugar, return the ribs, cover and braise at 160C. Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk. Reduce the braising liquid to a glaze and spoon it over the ribs to serve with the mash.
W: Dulce de leche biscuits for the Buenos Aires recruits.

Beat the butter and sugar, then the yolks and zest, and mix in the flours and baking powder to a soft dough. Roll 5mm thick, cut 5cm rounds and bake at 170C until pale and set. Cool, sandwich pairs with a thick layer of caramel and roll the edges in coconut.
K: Cold lager poured into frosted glasses. Here's the beer, says Rasczak.
Pour the lager into 4 frosted glasses at an angle. Add a lime wedge if you like and serve.
